summary: CRM Refinement testing complete - All 6 new CRM sections verified working. Backend: 21/21 tests passed. Frontend: All sections accessible and functional.

lead_outreach.details: GET/POST /api/crm/outreach working. Status changes (New, Contacted, NoResponse, Engaged) working. UI shows 9 outreach leads with status cards and table.

inbound_leads.details: GET /api/crm/inbound working. Shows 2 leads from Instagram with source icons. UI displays source, name, email, phone, event type, status, received date.

follow_ups.details: GET/PUT/POST /api/crm/follow-ups working. Unified view shows Overdue (0), Today (0), Upcoming (2). Reschedule and Complete buttons functional.

comms_log.details: GET/POST /api/crm/comms working. All comm types (call, email, meeting, note) supported. UI shows entity selector and communication history with Add button.

owner_assignment.details: PUT /api/crm/assign and GET /api/crm/by-owner working. UI shows 14 unassigned, 1 assigned. Dropdown to assign owners functional.

clients_with_events.details: GET /api/crm/clients-with-events working. Shows 2 clients with Total Events (1), Lifetime Value ($0.00). Event history and comms log in detail view.

crm_stats.details: GET /api/crm/stats returns all expected fields: total_clients, active_clients, total_leads, new_leads, outreach_leads, inbound_leads, follow_ups_due

existing_functionality.details: Events, Event Orchestration, Culinary Intelligence, Business Clarity, Settings all accessible from sidebar. No breaking changes detected.

data_integrity.details: Lead model has new fields (lead_type, outreach_status, next_follow_up_date, follow_up_type). Client model has new fields (owner_id, lifetime_value, events). Existing data preserved.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed outreach leads during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Refinement is complete. 6 sections: Lead Outreach (/crm/outreach), Inbound Leads (/crm/inbound), Follow-ups (/crm/follow-ups), Comms Log (/crm/comms), Owner Assignment (/crm/owners), Clients (/crm/clients). All new endpoints under /api/crm/ prefix. New fields added to Lead and Client models are additive - no breaking changes.

features: Unified view of leads and clients
